storage: Room temperature, cap closed, away from the stove, sunlight and moisture. Pouches should be emptied into a clean, dry, closed bottle once opened. Use a dry spoon. A rancid or paint-like smell means it has gone off.
looksLike: A clear, golden-yellow to amber oil with a sharp, pungent smell that stings the nose. It is darker and far stronger-smelling than refined sunflower or groundnut oil.
shelfLife: Check the pack; edible oils usually carry a best-before date of several months from packing. Use within a few months of opening.
